description: This file defines parameter classes and related constructs used in FastAPI for HTTP request parameters, including query, path, header, cookie, body, form, and file parameters, as well as dependency and security constructs.

classes.name: ParamTypes
classes.description: Enumeration class for parameter locations in HTTP requests (query, header, path, cookie).

classes.name: Param
classes.description: Base class for request parameters with various attributes including alias, validation, and serialization options.

classes.name: Path
classes.description: Subclass of Param for path parameters, which cannot have default values.

classes.name: Query
classes.description: Subclass of Param for query parameters.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Subclass of Param for header parameters, with an additional option to convert underscores.

classes.name: Cookie
classes.description: Subclass of Param for cookie parameters.

classes.name: Body
classes.description: Represents the body parameter in a request, including media type and embedding options.

classes.name: Form
classes.description: Subclass of Body for form data parameters with a default media type for URL-encoded forms.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Subclass of Form for file upload parameters with media type for multipart forms.

classes.name: Depends
classes.description: Data class representing a dependency in FastAPI, including cache and scope options.

classes.name: Security
classes.description: Subclass of Depends for security dependencies, including scopes.
